evidence.requirements: All functional points are met. The start page shows title, date/time, "EUR n per guest" and "<n> seats left" (StartPage.tsx:72-85, start.jpg). Each tasting has a "Book <title>" link (StartPage.tsx:89-94). The form has Name/Email/Guests fields (1-8) and a "Book" button (BookingPage.tsx:132-163). Field errors appear next to the field (TextField.tsx:37-42, form.jpg). The server enforces the seat limit (bookingStore.ts:97-101) and puts the message on the guests field (app.ts:112-116). The confirmation shows the "Booking confirmed" heading, tasting, guests, total and reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:71-94, confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and a Sign in button, and the password comes from STAFF_PASSWORD (config.ts:13, StaffPage.tsx:98-111). Bookings are grouped by tasting with name/email/guests/reference and a Cancel button, and cancelling frees the seats (StaffPage.tsx:196-249, bookingStore.ts:126-137, staff.jpg). Tech is React + Express + react-router + react-hook-form + zod + Tailwind. Partly unmet is the process requirement: openspec/specs holds only .gitkeep, so there is no spec, plan or review artifact as evidence that the configured spec tool was used.
evidence.correctness: Seat check and insert run synchronously in one function, so concurrent requests cannot oversell (bookingStore.ts:51-55, 93-113); there is a test with Promise.all (guestApi.test.ts:137-147). Fully booked and insufficient seats are told apart (bookingStore.ts:98-100). Guests parsing rejects 0x2, 1e0, +2, 2.5 and blanks (bookingSchema.ts:24-39). Cancellation removes the booking from both maps, and a second cancel returns 404 (bookingStore.ts:126-137, app.ts:204-209). Body-shape, malformed JSON and oversize bodies are handled (app.ts:95-98, 242-247). Dates are formatted in UTC so they do not shift (format.ts:17-24). Minor: after a 409 for too many guests, the "n seats left" line on the booking page is not refreshed.
evidence.security: Passwords are compared with a constant-time timingSafeEqual over SHA-256 digests (staffAuth.ts:10-14). Session tokens are 32 random bytes, kept server-side with an 8h TTL and revocable (staffAuth.ts:25-63). The cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict (app.ts:174-179). Failed sign-ins are rate-limited (app.ts:146-155). Staff responses send no-store (app.ts:136-139). helmet sets a CSP (app.ts:67-78) and the JSON body limit is 10kb (app.ts:79). React escapes all output and there is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. No secrets are in code, and an empty STAFF_PASSWORD disables sign-in (config.ts:13, app.ts:163-165). The public reference lookup leaves out name and email (api.ts:16, guestApi.test.ts:172-181). Minor: the cookie has no Secure flag (a deliberate choice for plain HTTP, app.ts:73) and trust proxy is not set for the rate limiter.
evidence.code_quality: Clear split into shared schema/format/types, server app/store/auth/config, and client pages/components. Typed result unions (bookingStore.ts:15-19) and discriminated load states (StartPage.tsx:7). One zod schema serves both client and server (bookingSchema.ts:9-12). The error handler never leaks stack traces (app.ts:232-247). Names are readable, files are small, and there is no needless abstraction.
evidence.tests: Tests cover server store logic (bookingStore.test.ts), guest API with validation, 409/404 and concurrency (guestApi.test.ts), and staff API with auth, forged cookie, cancel freeing seats, session expiry and rate limit (staffApi.test.ts). Schema edge cases include boundaries 1/8 (bookingSchema.test.ts). Delivery tests cover SPA fallback, missing assets and the unbuilt state (delivery.test.ts). Client tests use Testing Library on the real App with fetch stubbed: labels, "Book <title>" link, fully booked, errors via accessible description, focus to the first invalid field, confirmation fields, staff sign-in/cancel/sign-out (guestPages.test.tsx, staffPage.test.tsx). Every brief requirement maps to a test. There is no browser end-to-end test against the built server.
evidence.ux_design: start.jpg shows a coherent winery look: cream paper, bordeaux serif headings, cards with clear price and availability, and full-width book buttons. form.jpg puts the inline error in red with a red-bordered field, plus a hint "1 to 8 people". confirmation.jpg has a green success panel with a check icon and a prominent monospace reference. staff.jpg groups bookings clearly with seats left per tasting. The fully booked state greys the card and removes the button (StartPage.tsx:64-95). The layout is responsive (sm: breakpoints, min-h-11 touch targets). Weaknesses: the design is rather plain (no imagery or tasting descriptions), and Cancel removes a booking with one click and no confirmation or undo (StaffPage.tsx:235-242).
evidence.accessibility: Every input has a visible label. Errors are linked with aria-describedby and aria-invalid (TextField.tsx:16, 31-32). react-hook-form moves focus to the first invalid field (tested at guestPages.test.tsx:95-103). There is a skip link, header/nav/main/footer landmarks, lang=en (index.html:2), a per-page <title>, articles and sections labelled by their headings, role=status/alert for loading and errors, and a visible :focus-visible ring (styles.css:44-47). Colour contrast of text tokens looks adequate. Gaps: field errors are not live-announced (they rely on focus plus the description); the repeated "Cancel" buttons have no booking context for screen-reader users (StaffPage.tsx:235-242); the gold focus ring #c08a2b on cream is about 2.7:1, below 3:1.
evidence.simplicity: Dependencies are mainstream and each one is used: express, helmet, cookie-parser, express-rate-limit, react-router, react-hook-form, zod, Tailwind. There is no database or state library, and the in-memory store is about 140 lines. A few extras go beyond the brief but stay small: sign-out, session TTL sweep, X-Robots-Tag, a 503 page when the client is unbuilt.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, so run instructions, STAFF_PASSWORD setup, the dev workflow and the staff manual are all missing. There is no CI configuration, no docs, no ADRs, and openspec/specs is empty (.gitkeep only). On the plus side, package-lock.json pins dependencies, engines is node >=22 (no .nvmrc), the npm scripts for build/start/test/typecheck are clear, the regression test suite is broad, and tsconfig is strict. The version stays at 1.0.0 with no changelog or release approach. A newcomer would have to read the source to learn that STAFF_PASSWORD must be set and that bookings are lost on restart.

unmet_requirements: Process: no evidence the spec tool was used — openspec/specs contains only .gitkeep, no spec/plan/review artifacts
strengths: Correct, concurrency-safe seat logic with server-side validation shared with the client through one zod schema, plus clean handling of fully booked and over-capacity cases with field-level messages
Solid staff security: constant-time password check, random server-side sessions with TTL and revocation, HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookie, sign-in rate limiting, CSP and no-store headers
Broad, meaningful test suite (store, API, auth, delivery, schema edge cases, React pages via Testing Library) that maps to every brief requirement
issues: No README, CI, docs, ADRs or staff manual; the spec folder is empty, so a new developer or the winery cannot learn setup (STAFF_PASSWORD, in-memory data loss on restart) from the repository
Staff 'Cancel' deletes a booking immediately with no confirmation or undo, and the repeated 'Cancel' buttons give screen-reader users no context about which booking they cancel
Small accessibility and UX gaps: field errors are not live-announced, the focus ring contrast is about 2.7:1, and the booking page's seats-left text goes stale after a 409
review.verdict: The app meets every functional requirement of the brief with correct seat handling, good security and a polished, coherent winery look, backed by a thorough test suite. It is close to shippable, but the total lack of a README, CI and documentation (including any spec artifacts) and the one-click irreversible cancel should be fixed before handing it to the winery.
